tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Keyword search across every Veil Press breaking story and Desk piece (headline, summary, tags and full text). Returns the best matches with url, published time, a snippet and a cite_as line.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: Latest Veil Press stories, newest first, from Breaking, the Desk or both: headline, slug, url, published time, summary, tags, sources and cite_as.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One Veil Press story (Breaking or Desk) by slug or URL: full text (markdown and plain text), numbered sources, confirmed facts for breaking stories, url and cite_as.

tools.name: list_breaking_stories
tools.description: Latest breaking stories from The Veil Press, newest first: title, slug, url, published time, summary, key fact, cover and share image URLs, tags and sources.

tools.name: get_breaking_story
tools.description: One breaking story by slug: full text (markdown and plain text), update log, numbered sources (primary or reported), images and url.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stories, list_stories, get_story, list_breaking_stories, get_breaking_story · Public sink: list_breaking_stories.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stories, list_stories, get_story, list_breaking_stories, get_breaking_story · Public sink: list_breaking_stories

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
